headline: Rane Holdings Limited files SEBI takeover disclosure under Regulation 31(4)
sum: Rane Holdings Limited has filed a Regulation 31(4) takeover/substantial acquisition disclosure with NSE, signalling a material change in shareholding or acquisition event in Rane (Madras) Limited. Transaction details, consideration and exact shareholding movement are not disclosed in the article excerpt.
detail: Rane Holdings Limited, the parent/holding company of Rane (Madras) Limited, submitted a Regulation 31(4) disclosure to NSE on 29 June 2026. Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 requires disclosure of acquisitions of shares that trigger substantial acquisition or takeover thresholds. The specific transaction details—consideration amount, shareholding percentage acquired, and deal mechanics—are contained in the full PDF filing.
